Instant prohibited-behavior article (527863): third-party EAs not allowed unless you own the source code; HFT strategies and latency arbitrage prohibited; copy trading from external accounts prohibited. VPN/VPS allowed (article 378005).
overnight_weekend: [uncertain] Conflicting official text. Instant article 528164 says overnight and weekend holding is allowed. But article 377999: without the Swing Add-On all trades incl. crypto must close by Friday 16:30 EST, with add-on BTC can be held; article 531445: positions must be closed 2 hours before closures of 2+ hours unless Swing Account. Unclear whether Instant needs the paid Swing add-on for weekends.

us100_btc: Official instruments article (378025) lists NAS100 and BTCUSD (not specific to Instant). Leverage on Instant: indices 1:10, crypto 1:2 (with News Trading and Holding add-on: indices 1:5, crypto 1:1). Lot limit not found.
drawdown: Official (article 527811): daily drawdown 3% (equity or balance, whichever higher, reset 00:00 GMT+3); max drawdown 6% trailing then static at initial balance. Per-trade risk: 2% of balance per trade idea (first breach deducts profit, second terminates); margin use above 80% treated as gambling.
consistency_min_days: Official: consistency 15% (best day max 15% of total profit); minimum 5 profitable days each at least +0.5%.
first_payout: [uncertain] Official: first two reward requests capped at 5% of balance; min request $100; frequency bi-weekly; processed within 1 working day after approval; default split not stated (90% add-on exists). KYC required.
news_gambling: Official: opening a trade within 2 minutes before/after major news is restricted unless the Swing/News add-on is enabled. Martingale/grid, excessive lots, margin above 80% count as gambling; immediate closure possible.
